package game

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"example.com/planet/game/clientsync"
	gameprofile "example.com/planet/game/components/profile"
	playerentity "example.com/planet/game/entities/player"
	worldentity "example.com/planet/game/entities/world"
	generated "example.com/planet/loadtest/protocol"
	"example.com/planet/protocol/msgid"
	"example.com/planet/protocol/pb"
	coredata "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	dataengine "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine/engine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nestwal"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/frame"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/heartbeat"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/loadtest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/protocol"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/session"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

type gateLoadObservation struct {
	key     robot.SyncKey
	applied time.Time
	kind    robot.SyncKind
	exp     int64
	level   int32
	err     error
}

// runGateLoad 是一个真实账号的热点诊断，不冒充 1000 人 MMO 容量。
// 普通 PB 请求与正式 heartbeat 竞争同一 World，on_change 不靠周期扫描推进。
func runGateLoad(t *testing.T, addr, ticket string, player *playerentity.Player, world *worldentity.World, business *nest.NestMgr, manager *entitysync.Manager, active *atomic.Uint64, projector *dataengine.Projector, wal *nestwal.WAL, store *gateProjection, real *realGateFixture, walDir string) {
	t.Helper()
	seconds, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_LOAD_SECONDS"))
	if err != nil || seconds < 3 || seconds > 120 {
		t.Fatal("load seconds must be 3..120")
	}
	rate := 100
	if raw := os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_LOAD_RATE"); raw != "" {
		rate, err = strconv.Atoi(raw)
		if err != nil || rate < 1 || rate > 10000 {
			t.Fatal("load rate must be 1..10000")
		}
	}
	reportPath := os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_LOAD_REPORT")
	if reportPath == "" {
		t.Fatal("load report path required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(seconds)*time.Second+30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	stopResources := loadtest.MonitorProcessResources()
	var resources loadtest.Resources
	defer func() {
		if stopResources != nil {
			_ = stopResources()
		}
	}()
	probe, err := robot.NewSyncProbe(8)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var requests session.Recorder
	var traffic transport.Traffic
	registry := protocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	generated.RegisterDefaults(registry)
	var client *session.Session
	var connection uint64
	var sequence uint64
	var expected robot.SyncKey
	// expected is only accessed through this channel: one outstanding Sync observation per connection.
	var observations chan gateLoadObservation
	var pending chan robot.SyncKey
	connect := func() {
		t.Helper()
		connection++
		observations = make(chan gateLoadObservation, 4)
		pending = make(chan robot.SyncKey, 4)
		expected = robot.SyncKey{Connection: connection, Sequence: 1, Kind: robot.SyncFull}
		if err := probe.Expect(expected, time.Now(), 5*time.Second); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		pending <- expected
		conn, e := transport.DialPlayerTCP(ctx, transport.Config{Endpoint: addr, Traffic: &traffic})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		client = session.New(conn, registry, &requests)
		receiver := entitysync.NewDecoder(frame.DefaultLimits())
		fields := map[string]any{}
		stream, expectations := observations, pending
		client.RegisterPushHandler(501, func(message *session.Message) {
			observation := gateLoadObservation{}
			f, e := receiver.Decode(message.Packet.Payload)
			applied := e == nil
			if errors.Is(e, entitysync.ErrStaleFrame) {
				e = nil
			}
			if applied {
				e = func() error {
					for _, obj := range f.Objects {
						if obj.Operation == frame.ObjectRemove {
							observation.kind = robot.SyncRemove
							clear(fields)
							continue
						}
						for _, component := range obj.Components {
							update := component.Update
							if update.SubjectID != player.ID() {
								return fmt.Errorf("unexpected subject")
							}
							patch, e := clientsync.DecodeFields(update)
							if e != nil {
								return e
							}
							observation.kind = robot.SyncDelta
							if update.Full {
								observation.kind = robot.SyncFull
								clear(fields)
							}
							for key, value := range patch {
								fields[key] = value
							}
						}
					}
					if observation.kind != robot.SyncRemove {
						var ok bool
						observation.exp, ok = clientsync.PlayerExp(fields)
						if !ok {
							return fmt.Errorf("missing typed exp")
						}
						observation.level, ok = clientsync.PlayerLevel(fields)
						if !ok {
							return fmt.Errorf("missing typed level")
						}
					}
					return nil
				}()
			}
			observation.err = e
			if e == nil && !applied {
				return
			}
			select {
			case key := <-expectations:
				if e == nil && observation.kind == key.Kind {
					observation.key = key
					observation.applied = time.Now()
				} else if e == nil {
					observation.err = fmt.Errorf("wrong sync kind")
				}
			default:
				observation.err = fmt.Errorf("unexpected sync without a pending action")
			}
			select {
			case stream <- observation:
			case <-ctx.Done():
			}
		})
		if err := client.SendPacket(transport.AuthPacket(ticket)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	wait := func(kind robot.SyncKind) gateLoadObservation {
		t.Helper()
		timer := time.NewTimer(5 * time.Second)
		defer timer.Stop()
		select {
		case v := <-observations:
			if v.err != nil || v.kind != kind {
				t.Fatalf("sync kind=%s error=%v", v.kind, v.err)
			}
			return v
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Fatalf("sync wait timeout kind=%s sequence=%d requests=%+v sync=%+v manager=%+v", kind, sequence, requests.Snapshot(), probe.Snapshot(time.Now()), manager.Stats())
			return gateLoadObservation{}
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
			return gateLoadObservation{}
		}
	}
	confirm := func(v gateLoadObservation) {
		t.Helper()
		if !probe.Observe(v.key, v.applied) {
			t.Fatal("unmatched observation")
		}
	}
	connect()
	defer func() {
		if client != nil {
			_ = client.Close()
		}
	}()
	initial := wait(robot.SyncFull)
	confirm(initial)
	base := initial.exp + int64(initial.level)*gameprofile.ProfileExpPerLevel
	var completed int64
	send := func() {
		t.Helper()
		sequence++
		key := robot.SyncKey{Connection: connection, Sequence: sequence + 1, Kind: robot.SyncDelta}
		if err := probe.Expect(key, time.Now(), 5*time.Second); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		pending <- key
		requestCtx, cancelRequest := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
		defer cancelRequest()
		_, err := client.CallChecked(requestCtx, msgid.MsgAddExp, msgid.MsgAddExp, &pb.AddExpRequest{Amount: 1}, func(m *session.Message) error {
			response, ok := m.Value.(*pb.AddExpResponse)
			if !ok {
				return fmt.Errorf("bad PB response")
			}
			if response.Code != 0 {
				return session.ErrRejected
			}
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("AddExp sequence=%d failed: %v; nest=%+v projector=%+v", sequence, err, business.Stats(), projector.Stats())
		}
		v := wait(robot.SyncDelta)
		completed++
		if v.exp+int64(v.level)*gameprofile.ProfileExpPerLevel != base+completed {
			t.Fatal("client state differs from acknowledged changes")
		}
		confirm(v)
	}
	beat := heartbeat.NewDriver(heartbeat.Config{Name: "gate-load"})
	if err = beat.Bind(business, func(id int64) entity.IThreadSafeEntity {
		if id == world.ID() {
			return world
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var beats, beatChanges atomic.Int64
	host := beat.NewHost(world)
	reg, err := host.Register("business", 100*time.Millisecond, func(heartbeat.Beat) error {
		n := beats.Add(1)
		if n%20 == 0 {
			world.Dao().SetExpGranted(world.Dao().GetExpGranted() + 1)
			beatChanges.Add(1)
		}
		return nil
	}, heartbeat.WithDurability(nest.DurabilityStrict))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = reg.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = beat.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer beat.Stop(context.Background())
	start := time.Now()
	end := start.Add(time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second)
	interval := time.Second / time.Duration(rate)
	next := start
	// dropped 只计客户端没有发出的节拍：send 等 PB 应答和 Sync 完成后才返回。
	// 服务端拒绝、请求超时与 heartbeat 跳拍分别观测，不能相加当作网络丢包。
	var scheduled, dropped int64
	baseline := business.Stats()
	signals := func() map[string]any {
		now := business.Stats()
		var rejected, deadlines, transportErrors int64
		for _, r := range requests.Snapshot().Messages {
			rejected += r.Rejected
			deadlines += r.Timeout
			transportErrors += r.Errors
		}
		return map[string]any{
			"client_pacing_missed":    dropped,
			"request_rejected":        rejected,
			"request_deadline":        deadlines,
			"request_other_error":     transportErrors,
			"nest_admission_rejected": now.Queue.Short.Rejected - baseline.Queue.Short.Rejected + now.Queue.IO.Rejected - baseline.Queue.IO.Rejected + now.Queue.Long.Rejected - baseline.Queue.Long.Rejected,
			"heartbeat":               beat.Stats(),
			"meaning":                 "independent counters, not additive; request_rejected includes business rejection; client pacing misses are unsent slots, not Gate packet loss",
		}
	}
	defer func() {
		if !t.Failed() {
			return
		}
		failed, marshalErr := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
			"verified": false, "phase": "failed", "signals": signals(),
			"requests": requests.Snapshot(), "sync": probe.Snapshot(time.Now()),
			"scheduled": scheduled, "completed": completed, "dropped": dropped,
		}, "", "  ")
		if marshalErr == nil {
			if writeErr := os.WriteFile(reportPath+".failure.json", failed, 0600); writeErr != nil {
				t.Logf("write failure evidence: %v", writeErr)
			}
		} else {
			t.Logf("marshal failure evidence: %v", marshalErr)
		}
	}()
	for time.Now().Before(end) {
		now := time.Now()
		if now.Before(next) {
			timer := time.NewTimer(next.Sub(now))
			select {
			case <-timer.C:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				timer.Stop()
				t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
			}
		}
		now = time.Now()
		if !now.Before(end) {
			break
		}
		if lag := now.Sub(next); lag >= interval {
			missed := int64(lag / interval)
			dropped += missed
			scheduled += missed
			next = next.Add(time.Duration(missed) * interval)
		}
		scheduled++
		next = next.Add(interval)
		send()
	}
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	t.Logf("load complete: requests=%d dropped=%d projector=%+v", completed, dropped, projector.Stats())
	// 即使后续排空失败也保留已完成负载的数据，不把它写成成功验收。
	phase, marshalErr := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"verified": false, "phase": "before_drain", "target_rate": rate, "completed": completed, "dropped": dropped, "drop_reasons": map[string]int64{"client_pacing": dropped}, "signals": signals(), "seconds": elapsed.Seconds(), "sync": probe.Snapshot(time.Now()), "requests": requests.Snapshot(), "traffic": traffic.Snapshot(), "projector": projector.Stats(), "projection_diagnostics": store.diagnostics(), "nest": business.Stats()}, "", "  ")
	if marshalErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(marshalErr)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(reportPath+".load-phase.json", phase, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = beat.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("stop heartbeat: %v", err)
	}
	// 最后一笔双实体事务在心跳停止后提交，提供两个 DAO 的最新持久版本用于重放核对。
	send()
	if beats.Load() == 0 || beatChanges.Load() == 0 {
		t.Fatal("heartbeat branch did not execute")
	}
	key := robot.SyncKey{Connection: connection, Sequence: sequence + 2, Kind: robot.SyncRemove}
	if err = probe.Expect(key, time.Now(), 5*time.Second); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pending <- key
	if err = manager.Unsubscribe(entitysync.SessionID(active.Load()), player.ID()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	confirm(wait(robot.SyncRemove))
	if err = client.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	probe.CancelConnection(connection)
	connect()
	recovered := wait(robot.SyncFull)
	if recovered.exp+int64(recovered.level)*gameprofile.ProfileExpPerLevel != base+completed {
		t.Fatal("reconnect did not recover authoritative state")
	}
	confirm(recovered)
	if err = client.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	probe.CancelConnection(connection)
	t.Logf("begin projection drain: %+v", projector.Stats())
	if err = projector.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("drain projector: %v; stats=%+v", err, projector.Stats())
	}
	if err = business.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("shutdown Nest: %v; stats=%+v", err, business.Stats())
	}
	if world.Dao().GetExpGranted() != completed+beatChanges.Load() {
		t.Fatal("ordinary and heartbeat mutations do not balance")
	}
	stats := projector.Stats()
	if stats.WALUnacked != 0 || stats.ProjectionFailures != 0 || stats.FatalProjectionConflicts != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("projection not clean: %+v", stats)
	}
	store.mu.Lock()
	var last coredata.CommitRecord
	var version uint64
	for _, record := range store.records {
		for _, mutation := range record.Mutations {
			if mutation.Key.ID == player.ID() && mutation.NextVersion > version {
				last = record
				version = mutation.NextVersion
			}
		}
	}
	count := len(store.records)
	store.mu.Unlock()
	if int64(count) != completed+beatChanges.Load() {
		t.Fatal("unique committed transaction count mismatch")
	}
	walStats := wal.Stats()
	if err = projector.Close(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	real.verifyRecovery(t, walDir, last, player, world)
	resources = stopResources()
	stopResources = nil
	report := struct {
		Verified                                                            bool   `json:"verified"`
		Scope                                                               string `json:"scope"`
		Scheduled, Dropped, Completed, HeartbeatCallbacks, HeartbeatChanges int64
		Seconds, CompletedPerSecond                                         float64
		Sync                                                                robot.SyncReport
		Requests                                                            session.Report
		Traffic                                                             transport.TrafficReport
		ServerAndClientProcess                                              loadtest.Resources
		Nest                                                                nest.DispatcherStats
		Projector                                                           dataengine.ProjectorStats
		WAL                                                                 nestwal.Stats
		ProjectionDiagnostics                                               map[string]any
		DropReasons                                                         map[string]int64 `json:"drop_reasons"`
		Signals                                                             map[string]any   `json:"signals"`
		FinalVerificationRequests                                           int64            `json:"final_verification_requests"`
	}{
		Verified:  true,
		Scope:     fmt.Sprintf("one real account; one Player + shared World hotspot; %d ordinary requests/s target; 10Hz heartbeat, 5%% mutation; same-process Go Robot; no Remote/Saga capacity claim", rate),
		Scheduled: scheduled, Dropped: dropped, Completed: completed,
		HeartbeatCallbacks: beats.Load(), HeartbeatChanges: beatChanges.Load(),
		Seconds: elapsed.Seconds(), CompletedPerSecond: float64(completed-1) / elapsed.Seconds(),
		Sync: probe.Snapshot(time.Now()), Requests: requests.Snapshot(), Traffic: traffic.Snapshot(),
		ServerAndClientProcess: resources, Nest: business.Stats(), Projector: stats, WAL: walStats,
		ProjectionDiagnostics: store.diagnostics(), DropReasons: map[string]int64{"client_pacing": dropped},
		Signals: signals(), FinalVerificationRequests: 1,
	}
	if report.Scheduled != report.Completed-report.FinalVerificationRequests+report.Dropped {
		t.Fatalf("pacing counters do not balance: scheduled=%d completed=%d dropped=%d", report.Scheduled, report.Completed, report.Dropped)
	}
	for _, event := range report.Sync.Events {
		if event.Received == 0 || event.Pending != 0 || event.TimedOut != 0 || event.Canceled != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("incomplete sync evidence: %+v", event)
		}
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(reportPath, append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("PASS Gate mixed load: %d ordinary, %d heartbeat, report=%s", completed, beats.Load(), reportPath)
}
